Summary (decisions and current status):
- Model variant: Recommend running rdx-7b-q4f as pilot baseline for cost/latency tradeoff. We will also stage rdx-13b-pt as the quality guardrail if accuracy regressions appear. (Decision: rdx-7b-q4f baseline)

- Tokenization/embeddings parity: Redwood will run a sample transform on a 1k slice and send parity report.

- Security artifacts: We will surface SOC 2 Type II attestation and an updated network diagram (redacted for public internet).
  - Owner: lauren_bishop@redwood.com — Due: 2026-09-14
- Evaluation gating: Propose three gates — ingest sanity, 1k sample eval (accuracy threshold 88%), and latency SLA (p95 < 350ms). If any gate fails, automatic rollback to rdx-13b-pt for that cohort.
  - Owner: marcus_lin@redwood.com — Due: 2026-09-12 (finalize thresholds)

1) karthik to run embedding/token parity test on 1k sample + attach parity report (2026-09-10)

3) marcus to confirm pilot model selection & finalize evaluation thresholds (2026-09-14)
4) lauren to pull SOC2 artifact and network diagram (2026-09-14)
5) Brightline to confirm upload date and PO timing (2026-09-21)

Notes: Please treat the parity report as time-sensitive — if we see tokenization drift we will need to re-run token mapping which could push pilot start. Also, SLA language attached is our starting point; legal can redline and we will track changes via the HubSpot doc link.
